opportunities.name: Plan a full city break: city facts, weather, hotel, two activities and a dinner, then note and email the plan
opportunities.description: In the Wikipedia tab, search "{city}" and open the article; note the population from the infobox -> Switch to the timeanddate tab, search "{city}" with the site's search, open its Weather page and note today's temperature -> Switch to the Booking.com tab, type {city} in the destination box, set the dates {checkin} to {checkout} and {guests} adults, click Search -> Open the first hotel with a review score of 8 or more and note its name and total price. Do not click Reserve -> Switch to the Viator tab, search "{activity1} {city}", open the first result and note its name and price. Do not click Check availability or Book -> Go back to Viator's search, search "{activity2} {city}", open the first result and note its name and price. Do not click Check availability or Book -> Switch to the OpenTable tab, type {city} in the location / search box together with "{cuisine}", set the date to {checkin}, {guests} people, and search -> Open the first restaurant and note its name and the first available evening time. Do not click a time slot or Complete reservation -> Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "{city} {checkin}-{checkout}: pop <population>, <temp>, hotel <name> <price>, <activity1 name>, <activity2 name>, dinner <restaurant> <time>" and press Enter -> Switch to the Mail tab, click To and type {companion}@example.com -> Click Subject and type "{city} weekend {checkin}-{checkout}", then click Body and type "Hi {companion}, plan: hotel <name> (<price>), {activity1} and {activity2}, dinner at <restaurant> ({cuisine}) on {checkin}." -> Do not click Send. Click Discard to clear the draft
opportunities.site: wikipedia.org, timeanddate.com, booking.com, viator.com, opentable.co.uk, notes.localhost, mail.localhost
steps: In the Wikipedia tab, search "{city}" and open the article; note the population from the infobox
Switch to the timeanddate tab, search "{city}" with the site's search, open its Weather page and note today's temperature
Switch to the Booking.com tab, type {city} in the destination box, set the dates {checkin} to {checkout} and {guests} adults, click Search
Open the first hotel with a review score of 8 or more and note its name and total price. Do not click Reserve
Switch to the Viator tab, search "{activity1} {city}", open the first result and note its name and price. Do not click Check availability or Book
Go back to Viator's search, search "{activity2} {city}", open the first result and note its name and price. Do not click Check availability or Book
Switch to the OpenTable tab, type {city} in the location / search box together with "{cuisine}", set the date to {checkin}, {guests} people, and search
Open the first restaurant and note its name and the first available evening time. Do not click a time slot or Complete reservation
Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "{city} {checkin}-{checkout}: pop <population>, <temp>, hotel <name> <price>, <activity1 name>, <activity2 name>, dinner <restaurant> <time>" and press Enter
Switch to the Mail tab, click To and type {companion}@example.com

Click Subject and type "{city} weekend {checkin}-{checkout}", then click Body and type "Hi {companion}, plan: hotel <name> (<price>), {activity1} and {activity2}, dinner at <restaurant> ({cuisine}) on {checkin}."
Do not click Send. Click Discard to clear the draft
